EvidenceItem never directly sets a rule result; verified facts are required.

Human decision-maker, unresolved issues and material presented are recorded.
Agent returns SOURCE_COVERAGE_GAP and never infers the missing rule.
Every assessment records production_decision=false and source coverage.
